input_anchor_evidence.revision_scope_note: This pin follows the reviewed I-E06 hash/scope update for project diagnostic and FXAA/output-chain notes. Native equations, input edges, proof statuses and coverage counts are unchanged.

native_anchors.current_proof_limit: Decoded candidates and static package associations do not capture active override or resource winners.

Selected local-light shader consumption is recovered; REFR/base preparation, list construction and shadow allocation remain open. The first address packs pass-list entry zero for directional light and is a caller-trace seed, not a proven local-light producer.

Ambient builder/uploader and selected fog inheritance are static proof; interior cube precedence, directional parameters and live room ownership remain open. Extra RGB global 0x14331D6F0 has unresolved meaning.
Stable packing and ordered modifier composition are static proof; active IMGS/base pointers, IMAD curves and stack values are unobserved.
Selected material/key/layout segments are static; original mesh streams, full emission preparation, resource override and per-geometry light selection remain open.
Room links are retained in the project; native containment, portal-strict semantics, culling and light-list ownership remain open.
Selected Effect fog uploads are traced. Effect material/blending and VOLI selection/composition remain distinct open routes.
Native terrain response and active INI/GMST settings are unresolved. Authored flags do not establish effective visibility or illumination.

query_queue.question: Resolve exact records and resources before comparing visuals.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: For any later authorized archive study, hash the archive, selected optional plugins and every used NIF/texture/script; retain masters and winning FormIDs. Compare base and REFR fields separately.
query_queue.acceptance: A reproducible manifest plus a typed plugin/asset diff; no installation is required.

query_queue.question: Trace REFR/base light fields to the effective geometry list.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Trace callers and pointer producers around 0x14154B770 and 0x141548820; find local-list construction, radius/fade/color overrides, transform/scale, enable-parent and scripted updates. Keep the directional entry-zero path separate.
query_queue.acceptance: One pinned source light and placement must match an effective object, list membership, shader constants and visibility for a selected draw.

query_queue.question: Recover shadow allocation and mesh-dependent light selection.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Follow local-list count/order and shadow-channel allocation. Locate the actual cap, replacement policy and per-geometry selection. Do not adopt an author-stated four-light limit as a native coefficient.
query_queue.acceptance: Static bytes must identify the policy; later isolated geometry/partition and added-light controls must reproduce selection and flicker changes.

query_queue.question: Close interior template, room and ambient precedence.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Continue CELL/LGTM and room-owner producers into 0x1414EC3B0 and 0x14154B880. Trace inheritance masks, explicit black/zero, six-face colors, directional angles/fade and source identity.
query_queue.acceptance: A cell plus room override must yield one proven ambient cube and fog owner, with source values and per-view constants retained.

query_queue.question: Separate base image-space changes from active modifiers.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Trace manager +0xA8/+0xB0 writers and concrete curve owners through 0x1414EEC10, 0x14153D860 and 0x14065A250. Check adaptive state and final contrast/brightness/white-scale/tint values.
query_queue.acceptance: Effective IMGS identity, ordered IMAD instances, curve times/strengths and uploaded constants must be captured together before attributing brightness.

query_queue.question: Trace glowing fixtures independently of attached lights.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Recover emission/glow-map, external emittance, vertex-color/controller and texture-set routes through material loader/setup and key selection. Distinguish a visible emissive fixture from an illuminating light object.
query_queue.acceptance: One fixture must have separate receipts for material emission and placed-light contribution, including day/night or weather controller inputs.

query_queue.question: Recover portal-strict and multibound behavior.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Start from original LIGH/REFR/room-loader identities and scene-node participation; follow bit tests to room/portal traversal, light-list filtering and shadow geometry. No target behavior address is yet pinned for this flag.
query_queue.acceptance: Bytes must connect the flag to a branch; later same-room/adjacent-room controls must capture object visibility and light membership, including custom geometry.

query_queue.question: Separate distance fog, fog geometry and volumetrics.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Trace Effect material/texture/blend producers around 0x141556840/0x141556C40/0x141557090, and VOLI selection independently. Preserve CELL/LGTM range/color evidence as its own route.
query_queue.acceptance: A later isolated comparison must identify which pass changed and record effect geometry, distance-fog constants, volumetric state and image-space output separately.

query_queue.question: Trace landscape-light and no-fade flags against active settings.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: Locate LIGH flag decoding and the owning geometry/terrain/list visibility branch; follow active fade-distance setting consumers. Do not substitute a settings catalog for applied INI state.
query_queue.acceptance: A source flag and active distance setting must match list membership and terrain contribution at measured distances.

query_queue.question: Test author compatibility claims at the owning layers.
query_queue.bounded_research_action: For a later authorized comparison, fix native executable, load order, resources, cell, camera, time, weather, ENB/Community Shaders status and settled exposure. Change one documented mod control at a time.
query_queue.acceptance: Record/asset winners and effective constants must be explained before screenshot differences are used to propose renderer changes.
